name: Training Employment Pass
summary: A pass for practical training in Singapore, valid for up to 3 months and not renewable. It fits students whose training attachment is part of their course, or trainees sent by a foreign office or subsidiary of the employer, rather than someone taking an ordinary job.

requirements.text: You must be a foreign student whose training attachment is part of your course of study, or a trainee from the employer's foreign office or subsidiary.

sources.quote: You can apply for a Training Employment Pass (TEP) if you wish to hire a foreign student or a trainee from a foreign office or subsidiary.
The training attachment in Singapore must be part of their course of study.

requirements.text: A student must be studying at an acceptable institution or earn a fixed monthly salary of at least S$3,000. A trainee from a foreign office must earn at least S$3,000.

sources.quote: They must be studying at an acceptable institution or earn a fixed monthly salary of at least $3,000.
To hire a trainee from your foreign office or subsidiary: They must earn a fixed monthly salary of at least $3,000.

requirements.text: If you have held a Training Employment Pass before, you cannot get another one for the same type of training.

sources.quote: If the candidate has held a TEP before, they will not be eligible for another one for the same type of training.

requirements.text: MOM may reject the application if the employer has a high number or proportion of these passes compared with similar companies in its industry.

sources.quote: Your application may be rejected if your company has a high number or proportion of TEP applications or holders compared to similar companies in your industry.

requirements.text: The pass is valid for up to 3 months and cannot be renewed.

sources.quote: The Training Employment Pass is valid for up to 3 months and is not renewable.
